## Checklist

- [ ] New text for the user is in `STR`, in English and in Italian
- [ ] A show written by the previous release still opens, or the exception is under "Compatibility" in `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] A line in `CHANGELOG.md` under the release that is not yet released
- [ ] No library, no network request, no built file in the commit
